$description: FRAME/12 canonical design tokens (Paper Light & Flashback Dark colors, font stacks, 12/20/32px gutters, 2.5px ink stroke, and 12fps on-twos motion).

ink.$description: Primary ink text and active fill (--f-ink).

rule.$description: 2.5px panel border and structural rule ink (--f-rule).

grid.$description: Hairline table and chart grid rule (--f-grid).

display.$value: var(--font-dela-gothic-one, "Dela Gothic One"), "f12DisplayFallback", "f12DisplayFallbackDejaVu", "Arial Black", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
display.$description: Display headlines and hero metric numerals (--font-f-display).

body.$value: var(--font-zen-kaku-gothic-new, "Zen Kaku Gothic New"), "f12BodyFallback", "f12BodyFallbackDejaVu", "Hiragino Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
body.$description: Body copy, form controls, and descriptions (--font-f-body).

mono.$value: var(--font-m-plus-1-code, "M PLUS 1 Code"), "f12MonoFallbackConsolas", "f12MonoFallback", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
mono.$description: Cut labels, eyebrows, tabular metrics, and code (--font-f-mono).

pair.$description: Paired panels and compact control groups (--f-gutter-pair).

scene.$description: Panels and columns within the same scene (--f-gutter-scene).

change.$description: Vertical separation between scenes on a Sheet (--f-gutter-change).

ink.$description: Expressive panel border and control stroke width (--f-stroke).

pose.$description: Duration of a single pose held on twos at 12fps (--f-pose).

fps.$description: Stepped animation frame rate on twos (--f-fps).

sheet.$description: Storyboard sheet elevation shadow over the desk (--f-shadow-sheet).
